newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: COLOMBIA JULY COFFEE CROP UP ON MONTH, DOWN ON YR.
newsitem.headline: COLOMBIA JULY COFFEE CROP UP ON MONTH, DOWN ON YR.

text.p: Colombia harvested 946,000 60-kg bags of coffee in July compared to 622,000 bags in the same month last year, National Coffee Growers' Federation said Wednesday.
The results take the coffee crop for the January to July period to 5.6 million bags compared to 6.0 million bags in the first seven months of 1996, federation statistics showed.

In the current coffee year which started in October 1996, the total crop to July is running at 9.3 million 60-kg bags, down from the 11.4 million bags seen at the same stage of the 1995/96 coffee year.

The federation has forecast a total harvest of "about 10 million bags" for the 1996/97 cycle which ends before the start of the main harvest in September, compared to the 12.9 million bags in the 1995/96 year.

The federation said Colombia's coffee exports, including federation and private exporters, totalled 804,000 bags in July compared to 894,000 in the same month last year. In the calendar year to July, Colombia has exported 6.5 million bags against 6 million bags in the same period in 1996.
In the October 1996 to July period, Colombia has exported 9.6 million 60-kg bags, slightly higher than the 9.4 million bags exported in the same period of the 1995/96 cycle.
